answer: A concrete approach: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. An identity earns only when its beacon recurs, its ripple survives audit, and a dawn from an unlinked peer confirms it.
